mutations.name: a JSON line that only gained a trailing comma still counts as a change
kills: a weakened CI-policy line against a plan approval is in scope when the only change past a same-position trailing comma is the approved entry

mutations.name: an entry matches a line whatever its indentation
kills: a weakened CI-policy line against a plan approval is out of scope when the approved entry lacks the line's indentation

mutations.name: a line the card cut at its width can still match an entry
kills: a weakened CI-policy line against a plan approval is out of scope when a changed line was cut at the card's width, whatever the entry says

mutations.name: one approved key covers every key the reviewer named
kills: a weakened CI-policy line against a plan approval is out of scope when a key the reviewer named is not approved

mutations.name: lines the card cap left out are taken as in scope
kills: a weakened CI-policy line against a plan approval is out of scope when the card cap left a line out or a file read closed

mutations.name: an entry matches a line in any file
kills: a weakened CI-policy line against a plan approval is out of scope when the approved line is also placed in a second approved file

mutations.name: an entry matches a line at any line number
kills: a weakened CI-policy line against a plan approval is out of scope when the approved line is also added to a second job
a weakened CI-policy line against a plan approval is out of scope when the approved entry sits at another line number

mutations.name: a trailing comma is no change in YAML too
kills: a weakened CI-policy line against a plan approval is out of scope when a YAML line gained a trailing comma beside the approved line

mutations.name: a trailing comma is no change with no appended line after it
kills: a weakened CI-policy line against a plan approval is out of scope when a JSON line gained a trailing comma with no added line after it
